sections.title: Rhonda J. Fry, *owner*
body: Rhonda Fry began Help Me Rhonda Bookkeeping in September 2008, after six years as bookkeeper and office manager for Hammond's Ferry. She has more than 25 years of experience in the bookkeeping world and has built a stellar reputation among our clients and community.

Rhonda enjoys problem-solving, keeping clients aware of their current cash flow, and having a hand in helping them reach financial stability. In her down time she loves gardening, stargazing, and taking pictures of her food before she eats it.

items.text: Help Me Rhonda helps me manage my entire payroll, bookkeeping and quarterly tax needs. I can't say enough good things about them. The professionalism and timeliness of this company is fantastic! When I call for anything, I usually get someone right away, and if not, they get back to me within the hour.
items.by: Clint Steerman, Metro One Ambulance Inc.
